text: The Decapotamon BC (Japanese: , Jūgawa Senkyō BC) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a BLADE base camp located in Noctilum, on the Decapotamon. There are no enemies here.
Deflection Shield Mirrors (Japanese: , Henkō Shīrudo Hanshakyō) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia. Six are needed for Supplies Surprise.

Dart (English dub: ) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found near North Founders Street in the Commercial District in New Los Angeles at nighttime. He is a member of the Prospectors Division.
Decoy DNAs (Japanese: , DNA Anazarēshon) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Sylvalum.
Dark Lanterns (Japanese: , Nandemokantera) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros at Slavebird Isle. Five are needed for Nopon Culture 101.
Dark Blattas (Japanese: , Dāku Buratta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Blatta family. They can be found at level 41-43 in Primordia at the Talon Rock Third Terrane.

Dawid, the Destrier (Japanese: , Shōgeki uma Dāvitto) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Monoceros family. It can be found at level 44 on the cliff above the ruins northwest of Emerian Battlegrounds in Cauldros. Defeating it is required to complete the eponymous Basic Mission Dawid, the Destrier.

Daemon, the Undertaker (Japanese: , Sōsō no Deimon) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Gerrid family. It can be found at level 39 at the southern dead end Den of the Dead in Sylvalum, emerging from the ground.

Daril, the Eradicator (Japanese: , Mekkyaku no Dariru) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Marnuck Ganglion member. It can be found at level 29 near the toxic water outside the Castaway Cavern in Primordia during nighttime. It is accompanied by a Marnuck Windtrooper and a Marnuck Sentinel.

Daril's Qmoeva (Japanese: , Dariru Sen'yō Kumūba) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Ganglion Qmoeva Skell. It can be found at level 54 at Starfall Basin in Primordia during daytime. It is the Qmoeva of Daril, the Eradicator.
The Damaged Zig (Japanese: , Hasonshita Jigu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Zig Ganglion machine. It can be found at level 35 southwest of Hilal Stronghold in Sylvalum.

Dazzling Liceors (Japanese: , Dazurin Kurāra) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Liceor family, and can be found at level 32-34 at FN Site 415, crowded around a Sand Aeviter, and at level 33-39 northeast of FN Site 413 in Sylvalum. They are replaced with Awakened Liceors during rising energy mist weather. One can be found at level 32-34 at Delusians South Summit, surrounded by four Divine Liceors; it is replaced by Stola, the Unchained during rising energy mist.

Darling Purgovents (Japanese: , Puriti Morumu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Purgovent family, and can be found at level 21-30 at western Lake Ciel in Sylvalum during the night.

Definian Clones (Japanese: , Definia Kurōn) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Definian Ganglion, and can be found at the Ganglion Antropolis in Cauldros. Most appear at level 54-55 throughout the main cavern, while another appears at 61-62 deeper in the area, in front of the cave with the Companion Potamus, and yet another appears at level 65 in the deepest part, close to a Lost Caro.

Definian Copies (Japanese: , Definia Kopī) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Definian Ganglion, and can be found at level 41-50 in Cauldros. One appears on the central mining platform above Dragonbone Promontory when approached along the west walkway, but disappears if the party gets too close before attacking.

Debuffs are temporary negative effects in . They are a type of Battle Effect and are the opposite of buffs. Debuffs can be imposed by weather or by battle arts. To recover from a debuff, a corresponding Recovery Art must be used granting a buff with an opposite effect. It is also possible to recover from a debuff by waiting a certain amount of time for it to wear off on its own. Debuffs with higher levels have stronger effects and tend to last longer than debuffs with lower levels. Resistance to debuffs mainly depends on the difference in level between the user and the target. An enemy/party member that is higher-leveled than the party member/enemy is more resistant to debuffs and their debu
Dawnstones are Precious Resources in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Five are required for the B route of Water Woes.
Damask Metals are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from black Seidrs. They are components in several Skell Superweapons.
Debuff Suppressor is a ground armor debuff resistance augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It reduces the duration of debuffs by 5% to 50%. The Skell equivalent is CutTime.DEBUFF.

De Ezich (Japanese: , De Ejiku) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Wrothian who can be found at the Wrothian Stronghold in Oblivia at nighttime, and later at Repenta Diner in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles.
De Sazon is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Wrothian who can be found in Oblivia's Wrothian Stronghold at nighttime.
De Soghu is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Wrothian who can be at the Wrothian Stronghold in Oblivia at nighttime.

Dale Gibbon (English dub: ) is a NPC in . He is a serial killer responsible for the deaths of Murderess's parents. When he loses to Murderess and Cross' troupe, they leave him to be eaten by a monster.

Dead Men Tell No Tales (Japanese: , Shisha Keikoku Teisatsu Ninmu, Dead Man's Gulch Reconnaisance Mission) is a Normal Mission in . It can be received from Stella at the BLADE Tower in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles. After completing this mission, the Zaruboggans join New Los Angeles, allowing their missions to be started. Although it is not required the Basic Mission Scouting in Secret can be used to locate this mission.
Data Probe Challenge (Japanese: , Chōsen no Dētapurōbu) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Hugo in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles.

Definian Downfall (Japanese: , Definia Senmetsu, Definian Annihilation) is a Normal Mission in . It can be received from HT665: Erio on a rooftop north of the parkade in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles. The Basic Mission The Final Faceoff can be used to locate this mission, but is not a prerequisite. The party disables the first two shields at the entrance to the Ganglion Antropolis, but upon reaching the north side of the first room they are told that the next barrier requires three keys; this is not mentioned in the mission objectives, nor does the minimap point to the keys. The First Barrier Key can be obtained from the Milsaadi Guard at the entrance to the southeast room, whil
The Dancer's Clothes are an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They must be retrieved from Oblivia's Scabland Fortress during the Normal Mission Quegga's Gift.

De Zing (Japanese: , De Jingu) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Wrothian, and can be found at the Port Side of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles. If route A is chosen during The Unbreakable Sword, he moves to Cauldros's Adder Byroad.

Data Probe Breakthrough (Japanese: , Yakushin no Dētapurōbu) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Hugo in the Outfitters Test Hangar, in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles.

The Daunting Sylooth (Japanese: , Fiazu Shirūsu) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Sylooth family, and is fought at level 36 along with the Cunning Sylooth at Delusians South Summit in Sylvalum during Turf War.

The Deep Blue Gem is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. The part must recover it during Stop, Thief! by inspecting a car in East Janpath Plain. The Mission Exclusive Black Simius is standing near the car but it is not required to defeat it.
Data Recovery is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from BLADE HQ and the primary destination is Oblivia.
De-stressing Delicacy is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a Diner Chef and the primary destination is Sylvalum.

Data Probe Evolution (Japanese: , Shinka no Dētapurōbu) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Hugo at the entrance to the Outfitters Test Hangar in the Industrial District.

Data Probe Progress (Japanese: , Hatten no Dētapurōbu, Evolving Data Probe) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Hugo at the Integrated Production Plant in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles.

Data Probe Revolution (Japanese: , Saikyō no Dētapurōbu, The Strongest Data Probe) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Hugo at the south end of the Outfitters Test Hangar in the Industrial District.
Day by Day is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located anytime at East Melville Street in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles between Hope and Cross.

Definian Love (Japanese: , Koisuru Definia, Loving Definian) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Lyvia in the Residential District's Ishmael Hills, at the round garden southeast of the Cathedral, if Definian Downfall A route have be completed. The set of objectives depends on the gender of Lyvia's human form, which is set to the opposite of Cross's gender when she arrives in New Los Angeles. When talking to the potential love interests, there is a prompt with two options, "Query" (ask them to describe themselves) and "Inform" (tell them someone wishes to meet them); The latter option selects that person as Lyvia's date.
Dagahn's Adamant Bands are prime materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Dagahn.
Dance of Deception is a special Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Nopon and a Saltat dancing. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Supplies Surprise.

Damage Control is a Squad Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is part of BLADE Mission No.11, and is unlocked if the Purgovent Leader's lantern was broken during Contamination Nation. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Deadly Entourage is a Squad Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is part of BLADE Mission No.19, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting eight Sylooths. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Dark Matter Phantom is a Time Attack Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked after Chapter 12 is completed, and features a level 55 version of the Vita boss's second phase. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
Danger Surge is an armor Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X that increases the chance of triggering the HP Risk Soul Voice.

The Delta Bliss is a ranged weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Level 60 Multigun, and the only type of Multigun in the game. It becomes available for development upon receiving the schematic FILE-R1306FC, which is received as a reward for Yelv's Affinity Mission Yelv's Partner. The mission rewards also include the three materials needed to make one Delta Bliss, but not the Miranium and Infernium.
Debuff Res Down is a stat debuff in . Debuff Res Down reduces resistance to all debuffs, so the enemy's existing debuff resistances decrease, making it easier to inflict those debuffs.
Decoy is a buff in . Decoy grants total evasion to a certain number of attacks. It will wear off after taking too many hits, so Battle Arts that hit multiple times can pose a problem.
Damage.GP-GAIN is a skell armor antidamage augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It grants a 15% chance of receiving 20 to 400 GP when taking Skell damage.
Damage.APPEND is a skell armor antidamage augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It grants a 15% chance of reducing appendage damage by 10% to 50% when a Skell takes a hit.

Defense is a stat in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Defense represents the damage reduction of getting hit by an attack. 1 point in defense will reduce damage by 1 point.
Decrepit Wings are common materials in . They can be obtained from Buio and Teneb Vangs in Makna Forest. Decrepit Wings are also available via trade.

Dawnview Grotto (Japanese: , Raikō no Iwaya) is a Secret Area in . It is located around the middle left of the Upper Level - Right of the Gormott Province, almost directly above Lyta Oasis. The area can be accessed via a rock tunnel from Twin Trunks Hill. The pieces of Diamond Oak needed to complete Umon's Ship can be found here, alongside a Treasure Trove and a fruit Collection Point. It must be visited to unlock Finch's level 2 "Leaping" Field Skill. There are no enemies here.
Deathbound (Japanese: , Desubaundo) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using a Chroma Katana.
Daring Shot (Japanese: , Bureibutorigā, Lit. "Brave Trigger") is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using an Ether Cannon.

Declessa Altar Hill (Japanese: , Dekuresu Saidan no Oka) is a Location in . It is located on the Lower Level of the Kingdom of Tantal, south of Zalmor's Crevice, at the furthest south-east point on the Lower Level. Therida can be found here during The Driver in Ice.

The Dalnes Stone (Japanese: , Darunesu no Sekihi) is a landmark in . It is located on the Central Plain of Temperantia, on the Blackday Peninsula at the furthest point south-east on the map, directly below the Ruins of Judicium. There is a Salvage Point here. There are no enemies here.

The Decaying Titan (Japanese: , Kuchita Kyoshinjū) is a level in . It is located in the Land of Morytha, between the Streets of Morytha and the World Tree. It consists of the remains of the Tornan Titan, specifically beneath where Auresco once was. Zenobia's Heart-to-Heart, "Stronger than Light", can be viewed here.
Delizé's Infirmary (Japanese: , Derizera Imushitsu) is a Location in . It is located on the Upper Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Dedicated Conroy (Japanese: , Eiketsu no Arukin) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Tirkin family and can be found at level 51 in Tirkinlandia in the Kingdom of Tantal. It jumps out of hiding when the player stands in the middle of the three Tirkin Totems at the western end of the ridge. Conroy and the Totems appears anytime except during Ether Fog.

The Data Processing Room (Japanese: , Dēta Kanrishitsu) is a location in . It is a room located on the Lower Level of the World Tree near the Sky Bridge. There is a Treasure Trove here, and the Keycode necessary to gain access to Mizar, Elevator #20. After the completion of the Blade Quest Limits of Awareness, Adenine can be found here when she is disengaged.
Dealing Kingdoms are Board Game Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Elgeschel Hobby Store in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Dazzling Handkerchiefs are Textile Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Fallone Crafts in Garfont Village in the Kingdom of Uraya and from Silktu Textiles in the Indoline Praetorium.

Debuff Cancel is a Blade Art in . It cures all the debuffs currently inflicted on the Driver. It applies to Doom, Nullify Heal, Shackle Driver, Stench and Taunt. The AC System Reset Arts Card grants Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ access to this Blade Art, with cooldown that varies with equipment rank.

Deep-Green Oscar (Japanese: , Shinryoku no Osukā) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Ellook family, and can be found at level 41 at the Sacred Ice Caverns in the Kingdom of Tantal during snowy weather at night.
|-|XC2 = |-|TTGC = Deer Woods are Tree collectibles in and . They can be found in the Gormott Province and Gormott.

Dalya Armus (Japanese: , Daria Aruma) are enemies in . They are members of the Armu family and can be found at level 16-23 in the Kingdom of Uraya, particularly at Sternum Arch, on the Cobalt Cliffs, at Drillbore Bridge or on Funnystone Highway. Dalya Armus in the Stomach area tend to be of higher level than those in the Head. Five must be defeated to unlock Cressidus' level 2 "Earth Mastery" and Patroka's level 2 "Sanguine Steel".
The Deadfire Guldo (Japanese: , Deddofiā Gurudu) is a Boss in . It is a member of the Guldo family and is fought at level 52 at the Blocked Road in the Land of Morytha. This enemy drops no items.

Darkblood Guldos (Japanese: , Heruburaddo Gurudu) are seven bosses in . They are members of the Guldo family and are fought at level 50-52 at the Wastes of Hubris in the Land of Morytha. These enemies drop no items.

Daridan's Stack (Japanese: , Daridana Kojima) is a location in . It is located in the Rigitte Waters of the Leftherian Archipelago, between Baldotas Isle and the Isle of Sleeping Remains. There is a Salvage Point here, and a small second Titan with a gold Treasure Trove on it which can be reached by jumping onto the small Titan that floats in an orbit around the Stack. It contains two Rare Core Crystals and Gold.
Dark Gray Springs are Mechanical collectibles in . They can be found at the Argentum Trade Guild. In the , Dark Gray Springs can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.

Deidon Griffoxes (Japanese: , Deidōn Repādo) are enemies in . They are members of the Griffox family, and can be found at level 38-43 on the Central Plain of Temperantia between the Leaning Tower of Dorrick and Toxbloom Spring.
Deimos Sauros (Japanese: , Daimosu Saurā) are enemies in . They are members of the Sauros family, and can be found at level 90 - 92 on the Central Plain in Temperantia.
Dalian Lexos (Japanese: , Darian Rekusosu) are enemies in . They are members of the Lexos family, and can be found at level 49-51 at the Triedge Isle on the Central Plain of Temperantia.

Dayvol Symbols (Japanese: , Dibōru Shinboru) are enemies in . They are stationary aerial Standard enemies that alert nearby Ignas when attacked. They can be found at level 75-77 in Badfella's Cave Fort in the Kingdom of Uraya. They can be fought at level 90 during the Challenge Battle, Humanoid Alliance. Those enemies appears to be totally passive, they do not attack or deal damage, have no arts to use, and no Enraged aura, none are assigned to them.

Dark Fireflies are Insect collectibles in . They can be found in the Spirit Crucible Elpys, in particular at the southernmost point of the lower level of the Chamber of Offering, just to the east of the exit to the Lower Level, and the southernmost point of Subterranean Lake Galantia. One is needed to create Titan Illuminations by using Dahlia's Icecraft.
Dark Sprouts are Vegetable collectibles in . They can be found in the Land of Morytha.
Death Mushrooms are Vegetable collectibles in . They can be found in Temperantia, in particular from the Collection Point at Aegishammer near Pernicious Benf's Tombstone.
Deep Fellstones are Ore collectibles in . They can be found in the Spirit Crucible Elpys.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Dark Orbs (Japanese: , Dāku Ōbu) are accessories in and . They increase all damage dealt by up to 60% when at least one party member is incapacitated. The Eraser Orb, Bloody Orb and Demon Orb accessories offer stronger instances of this equipment's effect.
Decimator (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using the Shield Hammer.

Deep Droplets are Treasure items in . They can be obtained through Salvaging at the Canyon of Husks in the Spirit Crucible Elpys. Two are needed in order to trade for the "Vier Set" at Unita Trading in Garfont Village.
DeAlego Trading is a shop in . It is run by Parelene and can be found in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal. It is specialized in Exchange.
Deadly Twister (Japanese: , Deddorīsukuryū, Lit. "Deadly Screw") is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using Knuckle Claws.
Dead Clocks are Treasure items in . They can be obtained through Salvaging at the Dalnes Stone in Temperantia.

Dark Matter Chips are Core Chips in . They can be dropped by several enemies in the World Tree and the Land of Morytha. Dark Matter Chips share their appearance with Axion Chips and Mirror Matter Chips. __TOC__

Deck Duty (Japanese: , Kanpan no Mihari) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in Garfont Village by talking to Hamlish after the Garfont Mercenaries reach Merc Level 4. The time required to complete this mission is 100 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 25 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Ice Mastery" and "Clairvoyant Eye" Field Skills.

Darml Lysaats (Japanese: , Dāmu Shīsu) are enemies in . They are members of the Lysaat family, and can be found at level 28-30 at the Fief of Forgetfulness in the Empire of Mor Ardain. Five of them must be defeated to unlock Adenine's level 3 Slipstream.

Dagus Lysaats (Japanese: , Dagosu Shīsu) are enemies in . They are members of the Lysaat family, and can be found at level 42-44 in the Leftherian Archipelago's Lud Cloudway, halfway between the Rigitte and Fonsett landmarks. Some of them can be summoned by Perplexed Stoyan when using its art "Mega Wave".
Damodan Crustips (Japanese: , Damodan Shuribu) are enemies in . They are members of the Crustip family, and can be found at level 40-44 at Daridan's Stack in the Leftherian Archipelago.

Dajan Sovereigns (Japanese: , Dagyan Roiyaru) are enemies in . They are Phoebus-type Sovereigns that can be found at level 50-54 on Highway 8 in the Land of Morytha. They are classified as "mechanical enemies" in the Land of Morytha and five of them can be defeated to unlock Adenine's level 4 Harness the Wind, Electra's level 4 Shocking Assault and Poppi QTπ's level 2 Noponic Axion and level 3 Poppi Unlimited on their respective affinity charts.
Dalakio Scouts (Japanese: , Darakio Sukauto) are enemies in . They are Radclyffe-type Sovereigns that can be found at level 52-54 on Highway 8 in the Land of Morytha.
Dagas's Past: Leftheria is a quest in . It can be received from Dagas at the Central Exchange in the Argentum Trade Guild during Lost Kingdom.
Dagas's Past: Gormott is a quest in . It can be received from Dagas in the Ayvill Shopping District of Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain during Lost Kingdom.
Dagas's Past: Tantal is a quest in . It can be received from Dagas at Elmos Square in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal during the Blade Quest Lost Kingdom.
Dagas's Past: Folktales is a quest in . It can be received from Dagas in the Commercial District of Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya during Lost Kingdom.
Darryth is an NPC in . He is an Urayan who can be found on the platforms above Torika Alley in the Kingdom of Uraya. He runs the Fonsa Myma Informant shop.
Daffydd is an NPC in . He is an Urayan who can be found at the Gwenith Paddies in the Kingdom of Uraya.

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Dark Def Up (Japanese: , Yami Zokusei Damēji Genshō) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM/Upgrade in and . It reduces the damage received from Dark elemental attacks by up to 35%. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Dark Reflect (Japanese: , Yami Zokusei Hansha Shīrudo) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM/Upgrade in . Every time the user blocks a Dark elemental attack, this equipment nullifies the damage taken and reflects it back to the enemy. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__

The Dead Man's Message is a Key Item in . It is obtained at the beginning of the quest Glory from the Past. It can be received from the Dead body at the Little Banerro Ruins on the Upper Level of the Kingdom of Tantal.

Darkcyte is a Key Item in . It is received from Misimisi during Precious Yearnings by having her appraise a Strange Mineral from a prospecting point near the Wonder Spring Plaza Ruins in the Spirit Crucible Elpys. Upon appraisal, Misimisi responds with, "This is stone called Darkcyte. Quite rare jewel, only found glowing softly in very dark place. Is quite popular for use as charm to ward off evil spirits."

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Dark Absorb (Japanese: , Yami Zokusei Kyūshū Shīrudo) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM/Upgrade in .
